name: Case with integral board mounts
Hand check after cooling: Clear supports at the USB well and receiver in small pieces. Inspect the shelf and post roots. Seat the unplugged gauges and slide the receiver fully home.

name: bezel_1
Hand check after cooling: Rest the broad front on a flat surface. Check corner lift and the edges of the display cutout.

name: Reel rotor - reinforced pocket
Hand check after cooling: Remove the recessed support in sections. Inspect both ends under light. Fit the screw and sleeve and fold the crank through 90° before turning a complete revolution.

name: folding-stem_1
Hand check after cooling: The hinge eye starts on only 2.91 mm² of model contact. Trim the brim with the eye supported. Insert the pin and check for splitting.

name: grip_1
Hand check after cooling: Inspect the sleeve mouth for a split. Check that the grip rotates freely on its fastener.

name: collar_1
Hand check after cooling: Remove lip or elephant foot from the nonworking edge only. Check free rotation and axial seating.

name: R0017 keyed power cap
Hand check after cooling: The face detail and flange have thin local edges. Check the keyed corner and smooth return with the real switch.

name: grip-screw-keeper_1
Hand check after cooling: Check the thin washer stays flat and captures the rod fastener through its travel.

name: receiver-nut-keeper_1
Hand check after cooling: Support the 0.83 mm cap when lifting it. Check nut capture with the receiver unloaded.

name: key-board-retainer-west_1
Hand check after cooling: Inspect the two feet and thin return edges. Install over the inert switch board and check both ends seat.

name: battery-wire-bridge_1
Hand check after cooling: Inspect the two screw seats and tape slots. Test lead clearance with the maximum inert battery gauge.

name: rod-grip_1
Hand check after cooling: Inspect the handle shoulder approximately 34 mm above the print bed. Check dovetail engagement and the captive fastener before applying hand load.

name: status-charge-guide_1
Hand check after cooling: Cut the clear part free of its brim while supporting the elbow. Check the thin optical arm for whitening or fracture.

name: status-usb-guide_1
Hand check after cooling: Support the 1.2 mm wide light pipe while trimming its brim. Fit it to the USB lamp channel and verify light transmission.

name: status-power-guide_1
Hand check after cooling: Support the branch while cutting the brim. Inspect the bend for whitening and dry fit the power lens.

name: usb-c-shield-mask_1
Hand check after cooling: Peel the cool flexible sheet from its broad edge. Check the narrow webs for tears and fit a plug through the opening.

name: service-cover_1
Hand check after cooling: Inspect the flexible retaining edge and flex it once outside the housing. Seat the cover and verify removal access.

name: PKCELL-max-body-with-wire-sockets_1
Hand check after cooling: Check the two socket mouths and insert loose dummy leads. Trial the maximum envelope without a cell.

name: Adafruit-258-CAD-with-PCM-and-stubs_1
Hand check after cooling: Trim the brim at the end face. Inspect the rigid lead stubs and trial this gauge separately.

name: A1 display and controller
Hand check after cooling: Inspect the underside spans and connector outlines for sag. Check four mounting points before using the gauge for closure.

name: A2 reel sensor
Hand check after cooling: Inspect the small modeled features and locating holes. Seat the inert gauge on all four lands.

name: A3 haptic board
Hand check after cooling: Inspect connectors and the underside span. The gauge should sit flat across both integral rails.

name: Case-mounted PCB outline gauge
Hand check after cooling: Release the 0.8 mm sheet along its broad edge. Check both holes and the third rest before seating the display.

name: Top power switch board
Hand check after cooling: Check that the tiny simulated plunger survives removal and aligns with the cap. The printed gauge has no switching action.

name: USB indicator LED board
Hand check after cooling: Release the 4.8 mm gauge with a flat tool and keep it in a tray. Check the LED end enters the side channel.

name: USB lamp resistor board
Hand check after cooling: The gauge is only 3.2 × 2.0 mm in plan. Capture it in a tray during removal and verify the footprint with calipers.
